metadata.description: General-purpose agent skills for software delivery.

plugins.name: dipesh-task-planner-skill
plugins.description: Understand → recall → ask → plan (one approval) → execute in parallel waves → verify → hand over. Works in any repo.

plugins.name: dipesh-browser-control
plugins.description: Control your own browser profile (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi/Opera/Chromium/Firefox) or a standalone one via Playwright; optional OpenJev/Jev step model; learns site recipes and mistakes. Run scripts/bc setup after install.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: (Recommended, third-party) Karpathy-inspired guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: (Recommended, third-party) ECC harness: agents, skills, hooks, rules and commands for Claude Code.
